name: Look
label: Look
description: How the faces of this server look: its visual identity. One document is one look, written as a DESIGN.md. A person approves it, and from then on every face is built from the approved look of its name that was approved last. Born: here. Owner: the group brand. List: the documents of this class in the state approved.
title: name

name.label: Name
name.description: Whose look it is: the organisation, or one brand of it.

design.label: Design
design.description: The look itself, as a DESIGN.md: the exact colours, type, corners and spacing, and in words why each is so and where it is used.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: What the person asked for, and what they said when they saw it drawn. Kept so that the next change starts from their words.

tone.label: Tone
tone.description: How a face speaks to people: formal or plain, "you" or "we".

approved_by.label: Approved by
approved_by.description: The person who saw the look and said yes.

approved_on.label: Approved on
approved_on.description: When they said yes. Of two approved looks of one name, the later one holds.

descriptions.draft: Proposed, and shown to a person. No face is built from it.
descriptions.approved: A person saw it and said yes. Faces are built from it.
descriptions.replaced: A later look took its place. Kept as the record of how the faces looked.

transitions.name: approve
transitions.label: Approve
transitions.description: A person of the group brand has seen the look drawn and says yes. An agent does not approve a look.

transitions.name: replace
transitions.label: Replace
transitions.description: A person of the group brand takes the look out of use, when a later one has taken its place.
